column1: # Scheduling weights for scripts/test-roundhouse's parallel runner: seconds
# per unit, measured on a macos-latest CI runner (the slowest platform, so
# the one that sets every shard's wall clock). They order the worker pool
# (heaviest first) and balance ROUNDHOUSE_TEST_SHARD, nothing else: a stale
# or missing entry costs wall time, never coverage, and an unlisted unit
# counts as heavy (120). Refresh from a macOS sections run's timing lines.
